notes: Candidate clip moments for later best-of reels. Use video timecode in start and end, not wall-clock time. Exporter adds handle seconds around each clip for fades and final trim.

entries.title: Four diets, one mouth
entries.why: Eric explains the multi-lane architecture in usable public language, then lands the mechanism: different inputs produce different outputs.

entries.title: Four distinct blind spots
entries.why: Eric owns the design risk instead of defending it: independent lanes can disagree, stale verifiers can block or rubber-stamp, and different diets make distinct blind spots.

entries.title: The public voice has final say
entries.why: This defines governance for the architecture. Brain2 is a tap on the shoulder, not another public speaker.

entries.title: The director's notes leaked into the booth
entries.why: B2 names the failure exactly: Eric stopped performing the Salem table routine and let internal stage directions reach the public mouth.

entries.title: The stage directions escaped the script
entries.why: This is the compact diagnosis of the run: not bad character, bad role-boundary filtering.
